title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closes the US session down 3% at $63,168 with fear and greed at 29. Selling pressure dominated as price held below key resistance.

Hashrate remains firm at 879.8 EH/s while the mempool processes 76,445 transactions at a low 1 sat/vB fee, confirming healthy network capacity.

Key takeaway: fundamentals stay solid even as sentiment sours.

Watch overnight for any push above $64,000 or fresh downside tests into Asia hours.
